# aquaras

I created aquaras to solve some specific tasks and have added/will add
more functionality as the need arises. I would never have been able to
make things work without all the amazing people who create and maintain
the packages I’ve used. Thank you!

## Installation

You can install the development version of aquaras from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("Klorator/aquaras")
```

## Runlists for MassLynx

Create runlists for use with MassLynx (Waters LC/MS software) and
facilitate some of the data processing steps with the MassLynx complete
summary output file.

### Workflow summary

- Call
  [`ras.RunlistGenerator()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.RunlistGenerator.md)
- Input all the runlist info under “Well input”
  - Optionally: download/upload the tsv under “Full list” to save/resume
    a project
- Generate a runlist under “Runlist” and download the tsv
- Do experiments. Yeay!
- Call
  [`ras.SplitOutput()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.SplitOutput.md)
  and select the MassLynx complete summary output file (the
  file-selection window might be hiding behind RStudio)
- Analyze the results for each compound
- Publish paper!
- Design new experiments (rinse and repeat)

## Random group generator

Created the function
[`ras.Randomizer()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Randomizer.md)
to distribute a list of observations/compounds into groups randomly. Can
create multiple series and write to excel file (not default).

## TPA tools

Created the function `ras.TPA_calcFromIntensity()` which calculates TPA
from the intensity columns. It uses the raw output file from MaxQuant.

A few more functions, mainly `ras.TPAer` for calculating averages and
standard deviation of TPA columns.

## Fic workflow

Look at ras.Fic_workflow()

`df_Fic <- ras.Fic_workflow()`

…and ras.Fu_feces_workflow()

`df_FuFeces <- ras.Fu_feces_workflow()`

See the help page for the arguments. You probably want to adapt some to
your data.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Fufeces_runlist_template`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/Fufeces_runlist_template.md)
  : Fu feces runlist template

- [`generate_Fufeces_template()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/generate_Fufeces_template.md)
  : Write Fu feces template

- [`ras.Example_Runlist`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Example_Runlist.md)
  : Example runlist data frame

- [`ras.Fic_dataImport()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Fic_dataImport.md)
  : Load data for Fic & Fu feces

- [`ras.Fic_timepoint()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Fic_timepoint.md)
  : Extract values for Cell & Medium (values w/ timepoints)

- [`ras.Fic_workflow()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Fic_workflow.md)
  : Fic end-to-end workflow (!!!)

- [`ras.Fu_feces_meanSD()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Fu_feces_meanSD.md)
  : Fu feces mean & SD

- [`ras.Fu_feces_workflow()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Fu_feces_workflow.md)
  : Fu feces workflow wrapper

- [`ras.Randomizer()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.Randomizer.md)
  : Randomizer

- [`ras.RunlistGenerator()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.RunlistGenerator.md)
  : App for making a runlist

- [`ras.SplitOutput()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.SplitOutput.md)
  : Split MassLynx output file

- [`ras.StackOutput()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.StackOutput.md)
  : Stack MassLynx output file

- [`ras.TPAer()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.TPAer.md)
  : TPA - Do all the TPA stuff

- [`ras.add.blank()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.add.blank.md)
  : Insert blank rows

- [`ras.add.compound()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.add.compound.md)
  : Insert all analyte and blank rows for a compound

- [`ras.add.type()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.add.type.md)
  : Insert analyte rows for a well type

- [`ras.create.Runlist()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.create.Runlist.md)
  : Create a Runlist from data frame

- [`ras.darkModeDF_Options()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.darkModeDF_Options.md)
  : Options for data frame style

- [`ras.dateSignAll.update()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.dateSignAll.update.md)
  : Update Date, Signature, & Sample_name

- [`ras.ran_group()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.ran_group.md)
  : Random group

- [`ras.ran_series()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.ran_series.md)
  : Random series of groups

- [`ras.sanitizeInput()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.sanitizeInput.md)
  : Sanitize input

- [`ras.server()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.server.md)
  :

  Server for
  [`ras.RunlistGenerator()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.RunlistGenerator.md)

- [`ras.setup_dir_and_subfolders()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.setup_dir_and_subfolders.md)
  : Setup directory & subfolders

- [`ras.well.update()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/ras.well.update.md)
  : Update well info

- [`sigmoid_regression()`](https://klorator.github.io/aquaras/reference/sigmoid_regression.md)
  : Fit and Plot a Sigmoidal Regression Curve
